payload_en.headline: Rajnath Singh challenges US military support for Pakistan F-16 fleet

parents.headline: Rajnath Singh and Pete Hegseth meet in Philippines to review defence pact

paragraphs.text: Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh raised concerns over US military support for Pakistan’s F-16 fighter fleet during a meeting with US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth yesterday.
The US Defence Security Cooperation Agency notified a $686-million package for Pakistan’s F-16 fleet in December 2025.
Singh raised objections during the meeting regarding the F-16 aircraft package being given to Pakistan.
It has longstanding objections to US sustainment and modernisation packages for Pakistan’s aircraft.
Singh met Japanese Cooperation Minister Shinjiro Koizumi today.

"Advanced US technology provided to Pakistan could fall into the hands of third parties", India said, adding that "US military assistance to Pakistan could be used against New Delhi rather than being limited to counter-terrorism purposes".
"If anyone provokes it, it gives a strong reply," Singh said.
The 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM)-Plus was held in the Philippines today.

It is a platform where ASEAN member countries (Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste, and Vietnam) and its eight dialogue partners come together to strengthen security and defense cooperation.

The package (Singh Flags Concerns Over US F-16 Upgrade Package) is intended to extend the operational life of the aircraft and includes avionics upgrades, cryptographic systems, related software and sustainment support.
America recently approved a package of 68.6 crore dollars for Pakistan.

paragraphs.text: भारतीय रक्षा मंत्री राजनाथ सिंह ने कल अमेरिकी रक्षा मंत्री पीट हेगसेथ के साथ बैठक के दौरान पाकिस्तान के एफ-16 लड़ाकू बेड़े के लिए अमेरिकी सैन्य समर्थन पर चिंता जताई।
अमेरिकी रक्षा सुरक्षा सहयोग एजेंसी ने दिसंबर 2025 में पाकिस्तान के एफ-16 बेड़े के लिए 686 मिलियन डॉलर के पैकेज की सूचना दी।
सिंह ने बैठक के दौरान पाकिस्तान को दिए जा रहे एफ-16 विमान पैकेज के संबंध में आपत्तियां उठाईं।
पाकिस्तान के विमानों के लिए अमेरिकी रखरखाव और आधुनिकीकरण पैकेजों पर इसकी लंबे समय से आपत्तियां हैं।
